initialization: Warm start each original epoch-100 baseline; restart AdamW and map-order RNG. This is not an exact training resume. New predictor blocks are initialized to identity.
batching: Shuffle the 40 original training maps each epoch; four complete maps per batch, ten optimizer/EMA updates, every original transition exactly once. Encode each unique state once and repeat its context for four actions. All three candidates share this batching control.
ranking: Add weight * CE(-squared Euclidean distance / temperature, true successor). Detached EMA candidates are all and only valid states of each query's training map. No oracle rule or candidate restriction at inference.
checkpoint_selection: Evaluate original validation at epoch 0 and every five additional epochs. Save strict accuracy improvements; ties keep earlier epoch. Stop after eight checks without improvement, no earlier than additional epoch 40. Save both validation-best and last checkpoints.
configuration_selection: One common configuration for all three seeds; maximize mean original-validation accuracy of each seed's validation-best checkpoint. Baseline is eligible. Ties prefer fewer parameters, then baseline. Freeze selection before any new stress evaluation.
clear_improvement_gate: At least one percentage point mean original-validation gain and strict improvement in all three seeds.
final_evaluation: After selection is frozen, score train, original validation, rotated-validation diagnostic and all 24 stress maps for every candidate's saved best checkpoint. Use unchanged full-latent float32 cdist Top-1 decoder. Reuse existing simulation/bisimulation/CTL/LTL pipelines on the selected model if it improves on baseline.
leakage_policy: No new training maps, transition augmentation, stress/test examples or test-driven candidate/epoch selection. Stress is a previously inspected diagnostic holdout, not a fresh blind test. The 50 pilot test maps remain unscored.
stop_rule: Exactly three configurations times three seeds; no additional losses, weights, temperatures, depths or learning-rate trials after results. No new abstraction experiment.
